# Subway Seat for Termux

Background, foreground, cursor and the 16 ANSI colours. Termux reads one colour file, so switching flavors means replacing it.

[Termux](https://termux.dev) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/termux/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.properties`](subway-seat.properties) | ~/.termux/colors.properties |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.properties`](subway-seat-tunnel.properties) | ~/.termux/colors.properties |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.properties`](subway-seat-enamel.properties) | ~/.termux/colors.properties |

## Turn it on

In Termux, after copying the file to ~/.termux/colors.properties:

```sh
termux-reload-settings
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
